name: Scale of Obedience
primary:
Aura the Guillotine's Scale of Obedience from Frieren. Golden scales weigh your life against the mob you aim at within 24 blocks (bosses are immune):
• If its health is not greater than yours, it obeys you for 30 s: fights hostile mobs near you and follows you
• Otherwise the scales tip against you and the mob is only stunned for 3 s
self_description: The scales judge you: stone skin (resistance I), 10 s.
